topic.title: Asteroid belt
topic.teaser: Region between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter

easy.title: Asteroid belt
easy.line: Region between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter

easy.text: The asteroid belt is the innermost and smallest circumstellar disc in the Solar System.

medium.title: Asteroid belt
medium.line: Region between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter

medium.text: The asteroid belt is a torus-shaped region in the Solar System.
At these orbital distances, a Kirkwood gap occurs as they are swept into other orbits.

deep.title: Asteroid belt
deep.line: Region between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter

deep.text: The asteroid belt is a torus-shaped region in the Solar System, centered on the Sun and roughly spanning the space between the orbits of the planets Jupiter and Mars.
At these orbital distances, a Kirkwood gap occurs as they are swept into other orbits.
